info.title: contraagent monitor
info.description: Read-only views over a contraagent runs directory. Models: contraagent.monitor.api.

get.description: The title, the panel tabs to offer, and the version of this contract.
Every run directory, newest activity first.

schema.title: Response Api Runs Api Runs Get

get.description: The hosts that drive the runs, and each account's utilization over every run.
What the runs of a period add up to, day by day.

parameters.name: from

schema.description: the first day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 13 days before `to`)
schema.title: From

parameters.description: the first day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 13 days before `to`)

parameters.name: to

schema.description: the last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in `tz`)
schema.title: To

parameters.description: the last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in `tz`)

parameters.name: tz

schema.description: the time zone the days are in, an IANA name (default UTC)
schema.title: Tz

parameters.description: the time zone the days are in, an IANA name (default UTC)

parameters.name: run_group

schema.description: only the runs of this run group
schema.title: Run Group

parameters.description: only the runs of this run group

get.description:
One trend panel's body: its `fn(runs, period)` over the runs of the period, made on a
panel thread, and kept for the same period over the same runs (`Monitor.trends_panel`).

schema.title: Response Api Trend Panel Api Trends Panels  Name  Get

404.description: no trend panel of that name

get.description: Journal rows after line offset `since`; `total` is the next offset.
Every queued task with its dependencies and state, and the groups the UI draws as columns.
Every declared output/input contract: its file, the model it must satisfy, its status.
The tasks the run is expected to create and has not yet, from the run of the same flow that finished last before it started; a display only.
What defined each kind of task in this run.

schema.title: Response Api Definitions Api Runs  Run  Definitions Get

get.description: The resume cursor; `{}` when the run keeps none.
The run's live agent launches, process tree and Python tasks.
One task, by its key: journal rows, live launches, definition, input/output, transcript name.
A page of task `key`'s normalized transcript from line `since`; `since=0` is the tail page.

One run panel's body: a typed body (tiles, a table, charts), or any JSON object;
made on a panel thread.

schema.title: Response Api Panel Api Runs  Run  Panels  Name  Get

404.description: no run panel of that name

get.description: The run, live: journal rows as they land, then each other view when it changes.

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each message is one `RunEvent`

get.description: Task `key`'s transcript, live: the tail page, then the events after it as they are written.

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each message is one `StreamMessage`

404.description: not a plain run id or task key

account.title: Account
account.description: the account the readings are of (`QuotaReading.account`); empty when not known

rests.title: Rests
rests.description: its rests now (`/api/hosts`): those a live run began and that have not ended, nor passed their `until`

AccountQuota.title: AccountQuota
AccountQuota.description:
One account's subscription utilization over a run. `last` was taken when the
account's last session started, so it leaves out that session's own use.

cmd.title: Cmd
cmd.description: the first three words of the command line

role.title: Role
role.description: the role it runs as, from the prompt's TELEMETRY line; empty when none

AgentProcess.title: AgentProcess
AgentProcess.description:
One live agent launch: the topmost process of a coding-agent CLI, found by its
`CONTRAAGENT_*` environment; or, for an agent behind a library-call backend (no
child process), the run's own process, from its in-flight marker, with empty
`cmd`, `full_cmd`, `role`, `model` and `plugin`.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

BlocksBody.title: BlocksBody
BlocksBody.description: Bodies one under another: a panel of several parts.

Changes.title: Changes
Changes.description:
The files one attempt changed under its task's `changes` patterns, as paths relative
to the working directory: those it `created`, `modified` and `deleted`. Of a failed
attempt's created files, `removed` lists those the runner removed, and `kept` those it
left in place because the kind keeps them (`keep_failed_changes`).

ChartSeries.title: ChartSeries
ChartSeries.description: One series: a value per label of the chart's `x`; null where it has none.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

language.title: Language
language.description: a name of `LANGUAGES` or a file extension; '': plain text

start.title: Start
start.description: the number of the first line

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.description: lines marked: a line, or a range, both ends included

path.title: Path
path.description: the file the text is, named over it

wrap.title: Wrap
wrap.description: long lines wrap; otherwise they scroll sideways

CodeBody.title: CodeBody
CodeBody.description:
A text shown as code: highlighted by its `language` (one of `LANGUAGES`, a file's
extension such as `py`, or anything else for plain text), with line numbers from
`start`. `highlight` marks lines in those numbers: a line (`7`) or a range of lines,
both included (`[10, 14]`). `path` names the file over it. Long lines scroll sideways
unless `wrap`. The monitor shows the first `CODE_LINES` lines (and at most
`CODE_CHARACTERS` characters) and says how many it left out.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

ColumnsBody.title: ColumnsBody
ColumnsBody.description: Vertical bars, one group per label of `x`; `stacked` puts the series of a label on one bar.

type.title: Type
type.description: JSON-schema type, `list[...]`, a `$ref` name, or `a|b` for a union

ContractField.title: ContractField
ContractField.description: One top-level field of the model a contract file must satisfy.

params.title: Params
params.description: the task's params that are strings, numbers or booleans

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: its input contracts (`InputContract`, from a `TaskAdapter` of the engine), checked before it starts

ContractRecord.title: ContractRecord
ContractRecord.description: What one task declared it reads and leaves behind (`contracts/<key>.json`).

producer.title: Producer
producer.description: input: the key of the task whose output it is

format.title: Format
format.description: what the file holds: one JSON document, any text, or rows (JSON Lines, `fields` those of one line)

preserve.title: Preserve
preserve.description: output: JSON pointers to the parts of the file the task keeps as they were (`*`: every member)

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.description: rounds it took to pass, when the journal recorded it

ContractSpec.title: ContractSpec
ContractSpec.description:
One declared `OutputContract` / `InputContract` (its record, passed through,
minus the raw JSON schema, which `fields` summarizes). `status`, `rounds`
and `errors` are on outputs only.

ended.title: Ended
ended.description: when it was found not resting again, ISO 8601; empty while it rests (or the run ended first)

CredentialRest.title: CredentialRest
CredentialRest.description: A rest of one credential (`rests.jsonl`): why it began, when, and when it ended.

CursorMessage.description: The resume cursor, or null for a run that keeps none.
CursorMessage.title: CursorMessage

CursorView.title: CursorView
CursorView.description:
The run's resume cursor. The REST endpoint answers `{}` (every field
absent) for a run that keeps none; the live feed sends `null`.

need_s.title: Need S
need_s.description: `cannot_finish`: the work it needed, in seconds

left_s.title: Left S
left_s.description: `cannot_finish`: the time left before the deadline, in seconds

flow_call.title: Flow Call
flow_call.description: `deadline`, `grace_window`, `cannot_finish`: the flow call whose time box it is; null for the run's deadline

rests.title: Rests
rests.description: `rest`: each hop passed over and why its credential rests

dependency.title: Dependency
dependency.description: `dependency_deferred` (releases before 0.7): the key of the deferred task whose output it read

DeferralCause.title: DeferralCause
DeferralCause.description:
Why a task was deferred, as data (`Deferral.cause`). `cause`: `deadline`,
`grace_window` (past the deadline's grace window), `cannot_finish` (`need_s`, `left_s`),
`dependency_not_queued`, `dependency_deferred` (written by releases before 0.7: a task
whose output it read was deferred, `dependency`), `rest` (the credential of every hop it could take rests:
`rests`), or a runner's own name. A field a cause does not have is left unset, and
`deferred.jsonl` records only the fields set.

DefinitionFile.title: DefinitionFile
DefinitionFile.description: One file that defines a task: its instructions (a task without a plugin), the role's agent file, a skill, the schema ...

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.description: how it is joined to this task, in the order `given_from`, `after`, `created_from`

DownstreamTask.title: DownstreamTask
DownstreamTask.description: A later task: one given from this task, waiting for it, or created from it.

model.title: Model
model.description: empty: the coding agent's default model

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: not in its coding agent's model list, or how its probe ended (`rate limited`, `timeout: ...`: no answer within the longest `timeout_s` of the kinds whose chain held it, ...)

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: the kinds whose chain held it

DroppedRoute.title: DroppedRoute
DroppedRoute.description:
A route the preflight dropped: not in its agent's model list, or its probe did not
complete. `kinds`: the kinds whose chain held it.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

url.title: Url
url.description: a path relative to the monitor (apps/<name>/...), or an http(s) URL

height.title: Height
height.description: the frame's height in pixels; null: the screen's under the header

EmbedBody.title: EmbedBody
EmbedBody.description:
A page of its own, shown in a frame: one of the monitor's apps (`Monitor(apps=)`)
by a path relative to the monitor (`apps/<name>/?run=<id>`, no leading `/`, so it
holds behind any base path), or an http(s) URL. The frame's URL gets `theme`, `dark`
or `light` as the monitor is shown. `height` is the frame's height in pixels; None:
the height of the screen under the monitor's header.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: the runs it holds, newest activity first

left_out.title: Left Out
left_out.description: the views it does not hold: `transcripts`, `processes`

redacted.title: Redacted
redacted.description: what was taken out of the views: `paths` (made relative, else `<path>`), `host`, and each key named with --exclude

ExportInfo.title: ExportInfo
ExportInfo.description:
What an export holds (`contraagent monitor export`): the monitor's views of some
runs, written as files and read without a server.

journal.description: journal rows sent before this message
journal.title: Journal

FileView.title: FileView
FileView.description:
A contract's file as it is now. `content` is the parsed JSON (for rows, the list of
the lines that parse), else the text (cut at 20 000 characters, `truncated`), else null
when unreadable.

id.title: Id
id.description: `0` for the top flow, `<parent>.<n>` for a child

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: the parent flow call's id; null for a top flow

function.title: Function
function.description: `module.qualname` of the async def function (or of a flow that does not wait)

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: the flow path where the parent created it, with its loops' passes; empty for a top flow

error.title: Error
error.description: `<type>: <message>` of what it raised (or what cancelling it raised); else null

raised_at.description: for one that raised: where the exception left its own code (mostly the `await` that failed), its file as `flow` gives it; else null

raised_by.title: Raised By
raised_by.description: for one that raised: the key of the failed task the exception is, the same in every flow call it passes through; null for an exception of flow code's own

time_box.description: its own deadline, for a flow call started through `time_box`; else null

unawaited.title: Unawaited
unawaited.description: for a top flow call that ended: the keys of the tasks created in it or in the flow calls it started that nothing awaited, waited for with `after=` or returned; they ran all the same

FlowCallNode.title: FlowCallNode
FlowCallNode.description:
One flow call (`flow_calls.jsonl`): one run of an async flow (the top flow, or an asyncio Task
its code created), or the flow itself.

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: `module.qualname` of the run's top flow (`run.json` `flow`); empty for a run of an earlier release

earlier_run.title: Earlier Run
earlier_run.description: the run it reads; empty when no run of the same flow finished before this one started

earlier_finished_at.title: Earlier Finished At
earlier_finished_at.description: when the earlier run finished, ISO 8601; empty when there is none

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: by tail key, in the order the earlier run created the first task of each

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: the entries' `cost_usd`, summed; null when none has one

Forecast.title: Forecast
Forecast.description:
The tasks the run is expected to create and has not yet, with their wall time and
cost, from the run of the same flow that finished last before it started (`run.json`
`flow`). A display only: the schedule never reads it, and a run that creates fewer or
more tasks than the earlier run is no error.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: the kind of the earlier run's first task of it

group.title: Group
group.description: the group its kind is drawn in (`PlanGroup.id`)

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: the function names of its flow path, outermost first

passes.title: Passes
passes.description: the passes of the loops around it, outermost first, each capped at 3 (3: the third pass and later); null for a loop whose pass was not recorded

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: the tasks of it the earlier run created

created.title: Created
created.description: the tasks of it this run has created

wall_s.title: Wall S
wall_s.description: the wall time of the `remaining` tasks, at the earlier run's mean per task (every attempt counted)

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: the cost of the `remaining` tasks in USD, at the earlier run's mean per task; null when the earlier run reported none

ForecastEntry.title: ForecastEntry
ForecastEntry.description:
The tasks of one tail key in the earlier run the forecast reads, and how many of them
this run has created. A tail key is the flow path's function names, the kind, and the
passes of the loops around it, each capped at 3.

ForecastMessage.description: The forecast, sent when it changed: a task the run creates takes one off it.
ForecastMessage.title: ForecastMessage

file.title: File
file.description: relative to the run's working directory when under it, else as recorded

loops.title: Loops
loops.description: the loops of an async flow whose pass `line` was in, outermost first; empty outside a loop and for any other frame

Frame.title: Frame
Frame.description:
One frame of a flow path (outermost first): a call site in flow code where a task
was created. A comprehension is not a loop.

GridCell.title: GridCell
GridCell.description:
One cell of a status grid: the state it is in, in words, and that state's tone.
`tip` adds a fact about this cell to its tooltip (a run's id, a count).

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

HBarsBody.title: HBarsBody
HBarsBody.description: Horizontal bars, one per label, in the order given.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

HeatmapBody.title: HeatmapBody
HeatmapBody.description: A value per row (`y`) and column (`x`): `values[row][column]`, null where there is none.

Hop.title: Hop
Hop.description:
One launch of an attempt on one route of its failover chain: where it ran and how
it ended.

up.title: Up
up.description: its reports keep arriving (a hub: a heartbeat within the TTL; one host: always)

last_seen.title: Last Seen
last_seen.description: when it last reported, ISO 8601; empty when it does not report (one host)

interval_s.title: Interval S
interval_s.description: seconds between its reports; null when it does not report

running.title: Running
running.description: its runs whose process is alive

unresponsive.title: Unresponsive
unresponsive.description: its runs last reported alive since it stopped reporting

quota.title: Quota
quota.description: per credential (account): its first and last utilization reading over every run; highest weekly use first

Hosts.title: Hosts
Hosts.description: The hosts, and each account's utilization over every run of every host.

InflightPythonTask.title: InflightPythonTask
InflightPythonTask.description: A Python task running inside the run's own process.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: the runs come from many hosts (a hub): `/api/hosts` lists them

export.description: set only in an export: what it holds; a server never sends it

Info.title: Info
Info.description:
What the UI shows before a run is picked: the title, the panel tabs to offer,
and the version of this contract.

JournalMessage.description: One journal row, sent once per row: the whole journal on connect, then each new row.
JournalMessage.title: JournalMessage

JournalPage.title: JournalPage
JournalPage.description: Journal rows after a line offset; pass `total` back as `since` to get only newer rows.

JournalRow.title: JournalRow
JournalRow.description:
One finished attempt. `key` is the stable `Task.key`, one task; `kind`
and `unit` are its kind and unit; `executor` says who ran it; `stop` is
`Stop.value` (or a Python task's completed/error).

KeptKind.title: KeptKind
KeptKind.description: A kind with no route left, run as configured all the same (`substitute`), and why.

prompt_truncated.title: Prompt Truncated
prompt_truncated.description: characters of the prompt not shown

LaunchEvent.title: LaunchEvent
LaunchEvent.description: Head of one invocation: the exact argv, cwd and the submitted prompt.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

line.title: Line
line.description: the loop's first line, which names it

pass.title: Pass
pass.description: one iteration of this loop, numbered from 1 since the loop was last entered in that frame; null when not counted

Loop.title: Loop
Loop.description:
A `for` or `while` loop of an async flow around a call site, and the pass the call
site was in.

MessageEvent.title: MessageEvent
MessageEvent.description: omp: a whole message or a turn's closing thinking. Either `role` + `text`, or `thinking`.

MessageUpdateEvent.title: MessageUpdateEvent
MessageUpdateEvent.description: A piece of assistant prose: `ev` is `text_delta` or `thinking_delta` (omp may send its other delta kinds).

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: hops: agent sessions launched on it (pool members tried on one hop count once); 0 for an other model only

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: what the coding agent reported; null when no session on it reported a cost

peak_context.title: Peak Context
peak_context.description: peak context: the largest input of one API call of a session on it (tokens); null when none reported one

context_window.title: Context Window
context_window.description: its context window (tokens of one API call's input) as the coding agent reported it; null when none did

ModelUsage.title: ModelUsage
ModelUsage.description:
What a run's agent sessions spent on one model of one coding agent, from each
journal row's hops (a failover's hops on two models count apart), a hop's spend on
other models (`Hop.other_models`) on each of them. Python tasks have no model and are
not counted.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

NoteBody.title: NoteBody
NoteBody.description:
Text beside the figures: what a part shows, how to read a number. `text` is
markdown (paragraphs, lists, emphasis, code, http(s) links; any markup in it is shown
as text). `tone` marks a note that warns (`attention`) or reports a failure (`failed`).

NoticeEvent.title: NoticeEvent
NoticeEvent.description: A line of session bookkeeping: init, a retry, a rate-limit status, a custom message.

OtherEvent.title: OtherEvent
OtherEvent.description:
Any other event: omp's bare lifecycle markers (`agent_start`, `agent_end`,
`turn_start`, `auto_retry_end`) and whatever a custom backend's registered
normalizer emits, including a known `type` whose fields do not match above.

OtherModel.title: OtherModel
OtherModel.description: What a hop spent on a model other than its own (`Hop.other_models`).

tab.title: Tab
tab.description: a trends panel's tab of the Trends page, with the panels of the same `tab`; '': on the first tab

PanelInfo.title: PanelInfo
PanelInfo.description:
A panel a domain registered: its tab label, tooltip and glyph, and what it is
computed over (`run`: one run, a tab of the run; `trends`: the runs of a period).

PanelMessage.description:
A domain panel's body (`PanelBody`), sent when it changed. `{"error": ...}`
when the panel raised.
PanelMessage.title: PanelMessage

value.title: Value
value.description: a number as given (an integer stays one), or text already formatted

PanelTile.title: PanelTile
PanelTile.description: A figure as a tile (`cae-stat-tiles`). `sub`: lines under the value, each a row of facts.

quota_caps.title: Quota Caps
quota_caps.description: the run's credentials that have quota caps (`run.json`)

quota_rule.title: Quota Rule
quota_rule.description: `module.qualname` of the run's quota rule (`Pipeline(quota_rule=)`); empty for none

rests.title: Rests
rests.description: each rest of a credential in the run (`rests.jsonl`), in start order

models.title: Models
models.description: each model the run's agent sessions ran on, in order of first use

services.title: Services
services.description: each start of a service of the run (`services.jsonl`), with its stop, in start order

preflight.description: what the run's preflight did (`run.json`); null when its run.json records none

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description:
The queued tasks, their groups, and the flow calls that created them. A run with
no `flow_calls.jsonl` (its tasks queued by hand, not by a flow) has no flow call.

PlanGroup.title: PlanGroup
PlanGroup.description:
A group: a column of the pipeline view (a kind, the kinds `Monitor(groups=)` puts
together, or the implementation kinds of a base kind), its members counted by state.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: when it was queued (absent for a node rebuilt from the journal)

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: the names it holds while it runs, its kind's `claims` filled in

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: its task call's `priority`: a tie-breaker in the queue, higher first

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: the credential its call options name (`.options(credential=)`), which every route of its kind ran it as; empty when it names none, or a run-wide override outranks it

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: the flow path: frames of flow code that created it, outermost first

created_from.title: Created From
created_from.description: keys of the results that reached its flow call between that flow call's previous resume and the one in which it created the task

flow_call.title: Flow Call
flow_call.description: the id of the flow call that created it; null for a task with no origin

given_from.title: Given From
given_from.description: keys of the tasks whose outputs it was given in its params: an output, or one item of an output that is a list, whose JSON is a value of its params; shown only, never part of its fingerprint

input_files.title: Input Files
input_files.description: the input files among its params, as its task call hashed them: `param` (its place in the params, `notes/0`), `path` and `sha256`; absent when it has none

base_kind.title: Base Kind
base_kind.description: an implementation kind's base kind (`agent_task(implementations=)`), its group unless `groups` lists it; else empty

level.title: Level
level.description: depth in the dependency graph, 0 for a task that waits for nothing

deferred.title: Deferred
deferred.description: why the queue deferred it, never launched (`deferred.jsonl`): a deadline, a resting credential; empty when it was not

deferred_cause.description: the same as data; null when it was not deferred, or the run recorded no cause

rerun.title: Rerun
rerun.description: why a resume ran it again although an earlier attempt of the run had finished it (its outside state changed, ...), from its last journal row; empty when no earlier attempt had

PlanNode.title: PlanNode
PlanNode.description:
A queued task (a `plan.jsonl` row, passed through) with its state and
layout. The journal fields (`wall_s` .. `attempts`) appear once it finished.
The origin fields (`flow` .. `flow_call`) say where the flow created it.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.description: the kinds with no route left that stopped the run (policy `stop`)

PreflightRecord.title: PreflightRecord
PreflightRecord.description:
What a preflight did, as `run.json` records it (`preflight`): its policy, the routes
it dropped, and, for each kind left with no route, its substitution, the kind kept
as configured, or the kind that stopped the run (`stopped`).

cmd.title: Cmd
cmd.description: the first three words of the command line

role.title: Role
role.description: the role it runs as, from the prompt's TELEMETRY line

ProcNode.title: ProcNode
ProcNode.description:
A process in the run's tree (three levels deep at most). The launch fields
are set on the topmost process of an agent launch.

Procs.title: Procs
Procs.description: The run's live processes. Everything but the run's own fields is empty when it is not alive.

ProcsMessage.description: The live processes, sent when a launch starts or ends (not on every age tick).
ProcsMessage.title: ProcsMessage

QuotaCap.title: QuotaCap
QuotaCap.description:
One credential's quota caps (`[credentials.<name>] max_five_hour_pct`, `max_seven_day_pct`):
the utilization (%) of a window past which it rests; None for a window with no cap.

QuotaReading.title: QuotaReading

QuotaWindow.title: QuotaWindow
QuotaWindow.description: One window of a reading: its utilization (%) and when it resets (ISO 8601).

ReadyMessage.description:
Sent once per connection, after the first round of messages: the journal
replayed so far and the current value of every other view. A row that
arrives after it is new, not part of the replay.
ReadyMessage.title: ReadyMessage

RetryEvent.title: RetryEvent
RetryEvent.description: omp: the agent retrying after a provider error.

run_group.title: Run Group
run_group.description: the label grouping runs (`Run(run_group=)`); the run id when none was given

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: journal rows that passed, not counting `partial` ones

not_run.title: Not Run
not_run.description: journal rows of tasks that never ran: refused for an input (`invalid_input`) or skipped

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: what the coding agents reported the run cost, in USD; null when none reported

quota.title: Quota
quota.description: per credential (account): the run's first and last utilization reading; highest weekly use first

wall_s.title: Wall S
wall_s.description: sum of the rows' wall time, rounded to seconds

last_ts.title: Last Ts
last_ts.description: ISO time of the last journal row, else the directory's mtime

running.title: Running
running.description: the process that runs it is alive

unresponsive.title: Unresponsive
unresponsive.description: its host last reported it alive and has stopped reporting (a hub only)

host_id.title: Host Id
host_id.description: the host that drives it; empty when its run.json does not say

run_uid.title: Run Uid
run_uid.description: the id no other run has, on any host; empty when its run.json does not say

stub.title: Stub
stub.description: a stub run: the stub agent, or a replay's recordings, played its tasks (`Pipeline(stub=)`, `contraagent run --stub`)

replay.title: Replay
replay.description: a replay: the directory of the recordings it played (`Pipeline(replay=)`), and with `record_missing` recorded into (then `stub` is false, and each played attempt's journal row says `replayed`); empty otherwise

row_extras.title: Row Extras
row_extras.description: the journal columns that are the pipeline's own (`Run(row_extras=)`), in the order they first appear

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: One run directory, as the run picker lists it.

SafetyStop.title: SafetyStop
SafetyStop.description:
A safety classifier that stopped part of a launch while the launch went on (Claude
Code reports them). `response`: it stopped a response of the launch's own model, whose
unfinished tool calls did not run; the coding agent tells the model and goes on.
`tool`: it refused a request of a model that a tool calls (Claude Code's `WebFetch`
summarizes a page on a smaller model), and the tool call ended in an error. `unread`:
the coding agent counted one whose words its reader does not recognize. The launch
ends as it would have (`completed`, often); a refusal that ends the launch is stop
`refused` instead.

name.title: Name
name.description: the claim name the service stands for

key.title: Key
key.description: the task whose claim started it

address.title: Address
address.description: what it gave its tasks to reach it; null for none

start_s.title: Start S
start_s.description: how long its start took, in seconds

start_error.title: Start Error
start_error.description: the exception of a start that failed (the service did not start); empty when it started

stopped_at.title: Stopped At
stopped_at.description: when it stopped, ISO 8601; empty while it is up, or when the run ended with no stop recorded

stop_cause.title: Stop Cause
stop_cause.description: why it stopped; null while it is up

stop_error.title: Stop Error
stop_error.description: the exception its stop raised; empty when the stop went well

ServiceSpan.title: ServiceSpan
ServiceSpan.description: One start of the service a claim name stands for (`services.jsonl`), with its stop.

SkippedHop.title: SkippedHop
SkippedHop.description:
A hop of the failover chain an attempt passed over without a launch, because its
credential rested: its route label and model (`model`), and the rest.

StageEntry.title: StageEntry
StageEntry.description: One transition of the cursor (`HistoryEntry`), its time as `datetime.isoformat` gives it.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

StatusGridBody.title: StatusGridBody
StatusGridBody.description:
A state per row (`y`) and column (`x`): `cells[row][column]`, null where there is
none. Each cell is coloured by its tone and named by its label (in the legend, the
tooltip and the table): the states of hourly cycles by day, say.

StreamMessage.description:
`/events/stream`: the first message is the transcript's tail page, then each
message carries only the events after the previous one.
StreamMessage.title: StreamMessage

items.description: Dispatch on `type`; an event whose `type` is none of the literals above, or whose fields do not fit, is an OtherEvent.

StreamPage.title: StreamPage
StreamPage.description:
A page of one transcript. `total` is the file's line count: pass it back as
`since` for the next page. The first page (`since=0`) is the tail; `behind`
lines precede it, fetched by asking again with a smaller `since`.

Substitution.title: Substitution
Substitution.description: A kind with no route left, run on the first route that answered (`substitute`).

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

TableBody.title: TableBody
TableBody.description: Rows of values, one key per column; a row's `_tone` is its status (a `Tone`).

link.title: Link
link.description: the key of the row that holds the cell's URL

TableColumn.title: TableColumn
TableColumn.description:
A column of a table body: `id` names the key of each row it shows. `bar`: a bar in
the cell, as long as the value against the column's largest. `link`: the key of each
row that holds the URL the cell leads to (http or https; any other is no link).

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: tasks whose last result was `partial`: ok, the output a placeholder; not in `done`

TaskCounts.title: TaskCounts
TaskCounts.description:
A run's tasks (not attempts) by how they ended. `not_started`: refused for
an input, or waiting behind a task that failed; `running`: running now (in a
live run); `waiting`: queued in a live run; `not_run`: deferred, or queued in a
run that is no longer live (it will not run); `cancelled`: cancelled once no flow
call waited for it (called with `.options(cancellable=True)`).

output_from.title: Output From
output_from.description: agent task: `file`, the agent writes its output; `message`, its final message is the output

preserve.title: Preserve
preserve.description: agent task: JSON pointers to the parts of its output file it keeps (`agent_task(preserve=)`)

output_of.title: Output Of
output_of.description: agent task: the kind whose output file it writes (`agent_task(output_of=)`)

base_kind.title: Base Kind
base_kind.description: agent task: an implementation kind's base kind (`agent_task(implementations=)`)

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: agent task: `[]`, a light launch with no tools (`agent_task(tools=())`); null, the tools its role allows

file.title: File
file.description: Python task: the source file, relative to the run's working directory when inside it

line.title: Line
line.description: Python task: the function's first line in `file`

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Python task: the fresh attempts after the first, each after an exception of `retry_on` (`@python_task(retries=)`)

retry_on.title: Retry On
retry_on.description: Python task: the exception classes that give an attempt a fresh one

TaskDefinition.title: TaskDefinition
TaskDefinition.description:
What defined one kind of task in this run (`definitions/<kind>.json`).
Beyond `kind`, the keys are the task adapter's choice; these are the ones
the bundled adapters write.

launches.title: Launches
launches.description: its launches running now; empty once it has finished (finished attempts are `rows`)

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: the transcript's task key for /stream and /events/stream, null when it has none

row_extras.title: Row Extras
row_extras.description: the columns of `rows` that are the pipeline's own (`Run(row_extras=)`), in the order they first appear

TaskDetail.title: TaskDetail
TaskDetail.description:
One task, by its key. Open: the `task_detail` callback merges its own keys
in (a failing one leaves `task_detail_error` instead).

input_files.title: Input Files
input_files.description: the input files among its params

TaskIO.title: TaskIO
TaskIO.description: The task's params, what it reads and leaves behind, and its neighbours in the plan.

param.title: Param
param.description: its place in the params: the param's name, then a list's index or a field's name (`notes/0`)

path.title: Path
path.description: as the params hold it: relative to the run's working directory, or absolute for an output file outside it

writer.title: Writer
writer.description: the key of the task it was given from whose output file it is; null for another file

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: for one `refused`: why, as the refusal names it; else empty

TaskInputFile.title: TaskInputFile
TaskInputFile.description:
An input file among the task's params (`plan.jsonl` `input_files`): its place in the
params, its path and the SHA-256 of its content taken at the task call, the task whose
output file it is, and its check as the task was about to start.

cmd.title: Cmd
cmd.description: the full command line, cut at 600 characters

TaskLaunch.title: TaskLaunch
TaskLaunch.description: A live launch of the task (a child process, or an in-process marker with empty plugin/model/role/cmd).

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: when the flow call started, where its deadline counts from (UTC ISO 8601)

grace_s.title: Grace S
grace_s.description: seconds past the deadline its `finishing_kinds` still launch

slack_s.title: Slack S
slack_s.description: seconds before the deadline from which its tasks are ordered for it

finishing_kinds.title: Finishing Kinds
finishing_kinds.description: the kinds that still launch past the deadline

TimeBoxRecord.title: TimeBoxRecord
TimeBoxRecord.description: A flow call's own deadline (`time_box`, `TimeBox`), as `flow_calls.jsonl` records it.

TokenUsage.title: TokenUsage
TokenUsage.description:
Tokens summed over API calls: an attempt's (its rounds and hops, in `JournalRow.usage`)
or one hop's (`Hop.usage`).

web_query.title: Web Query
web_query.description: the query, when the call is a web search

web_fetch.title: Web Fetch
web_fetch.description: the URL, when the call reads a web page

ToolCallEchoEvent.title: ToolCallEchoEvent
ToolCallEchoEvent.description: omp: a tool call carried on a message or turn (`acall`).

ToolEndEvent.title: ToolEndEvent
ToolEndEvent.description: A tool call's result. `tool` is empty for claude, which names only the call id.

ToolResultEchoEvent.title: ToolResultEchoEvent
ToolResultEchoEvent.description: omp: a tool result carried as a `toolResult` message (`aresult`).

cmd.title: Cmd
cmd.description: a one-line preview: the command, pattern, path, URL or query

web_query.title: Web Query
web_query.description: the query, when the call is a web search

web_fetch.title: Web Fetch
web_fetch.description: the URL, when the call reads a web page

ToolStartEvent.title: ToolStartEvent
ToolStartEvent.description: A tool call starting (or omp's progress update for it). `call` pairs it with its end event.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)

TreeBody.title: TreeBody
TreeBody.description:
A tree of nodes, folded and opened by the reader: files and directories, say. A
node's `code` is shown beside the tree when the node is selected, with no request
of its own: a panel of files returns their texts with the tree. `selected` is the
node selected first (its `id`; default: the first node with code).

run.title: Run
run.description: the run of `panel` or `task`; a trends panel names it

TreeLink.title: TreeLink
TreeLink.description:
Where a tree node leads, in the monitor: a run panel's tab (`panel`, its name), a
task (`task`, its key), each in `run` (default: the run shown), or a body of the same
panel (`anchor`, its `anchor`). Exactly one of `panel`, `task` and `anchor`.

TreeNode.title: TreeNode
TreeNode.description:
One node of a tree: its `name`, and `children` under it. `id` names it (default: the
names from the top, joined by `/`). `icon` is `directory` for a node with children and
`file` for one without, unless given. `badge` is a word beside the name, coloured by
`tone`. A node shows its `code` beside the tree when
it is selected, or leads elsewhere by its `link`; not both. `open`: its children are
shown at first.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: group -> cost, USD; a group with no cost reported is absent

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`

TrendDay.title: TrendDay
TrendDay.description: One day: its attempts (by when they ended), and its cost per group (`Monitor(groups=)`; a kind in none is its own).

TrendDeferral.title: TrendDeferral
TrendDeferral.description: A deferred task (`deferred.jsonl`), with its run; `cause` is `DeferralCause.cause`.

TrendDenial.title: TrendDenial
TrendDenial.description: Tool calls the coding agent's permissions refused, of one tool (`launches.jsonl` `denied`).

tasks_ok.title: Tasks Ok
tasks_ok.description: tasks whose last attempt passed, not counting `partial` ones

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`

TrendKind.title: TrendKind
TrendKind.description: One kind over the period. A task is one key of one run; its last attempt in the period says how it ended.

days.title: Days
days.description: every day of the period, in order

TrendPeriod.title: TrendPeriod
TrendPeriod.description: The period: days `from`..`to`, both included, in the time zone `tz` (an IANA name).

account.title: Account
account.description: the account the readings are of (`QuotaReading.account`); empty when not known

window.title: Window
window.description: `five_hour`, `seven_day`, or another window a reading names (`seven_day_opus`)

daily_peak.title: Daily Peak
daily_peak.description: per day of `period.days`; null when no reading arrived that day

hourly_peak.title: Hourly Peak
hourly_peak.description: per hour from the period's first instant (the first day's midnight in `tz`); null when no reading arrived in it

TrendQuota.title: TrendQuota
TrendQuota.description:
One account's utilization of one window over the period: each day's and each hour's highest reading.
A credential whose token was replaced has one entry per account.

TrendRest.title: TrendRest
TrendRest.description: A start or end of a credential's rest (a `rests.jsonl` row), with its run.

last_ts.title: Last Ts
last_ts.description: when its last attempt in the period ended; empty when it has none

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`

TrendRun.title: TrendRun
TrendRun.description: One run of the period: its attempts in the period.

model.title: Model
model.description: the model whose safeguards stopped it, as the coding agent names it; empty when not said

TrendSafetyStop.title: TrendSafetyStop
TrendSafetyStop.description:
Safety stops of one part, by one model (journal `safety_stops`): a safety classifier
stopped part of a launch, which went on (`SafetyStop`).

TrendStarts.title: TrendStarts
TrendStarts.description: Run starts by weekday (`weekdays`, Monday first) and hour (`hours`) in the period's time zone: `counts[weekday][hour]`.

TrendStop.title: TrendStop
TrendStop.description: Attempts that ended on one `stop`, and by which kinds.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: runs with an attempt in the period, or started in it

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: what the coding agents reported; null when no attempt reported a cost

TrendTotals.title: TrendTotals
TrendTotals.description: The period's runs and attempts, summed.

Trends.title: Trends

UnitPosition.title: UnitPosition
UnitPosition.description:
One unit's place in the per-unit step sequence; `inflight` are the work
items dispatched but not yet recorded.

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.description: how this task is joined to it, in the order `given_from`, `after`, `created_from`

UpstreamTask.title: UpstreamTask
UpstreamTask.description: An earlier task: one this task was given from, waits for, or was created from.
